events.title: Tomorrow, We Open the Store! (DEMO)
events.summary: Hey, future shopkeepers! 🖐️Tomorrow's the big day. DIY Shop Simulator DEMO is finally out. I may or may not be nervously hovering over the launch button as we speak. Your warehouse is waiting, the shelves need filling, and someone has to decide whether that drill is worth the price tag. What are you stocking first? Power tools, paint, or enough cement to build the entire neighborhood? Don't forget to add DIY Shop Simulator to your wishlist and join us tomorrow!The store is waiting. 🔨
